directives.name: prop
directives.description: Public component property. Becomes a kebab-cased attribute on the host. Read as `NAME()`, written as `NAME.set(v)`. `!` marks required.

anti_examples.reason: Type annotation required for typed reactivity.

directives.name: state
directives.description: Local signal. Same `NAME()` / `NAME.set(v)` access as props.

directives.name: derived
directives.description: Memoised computed signal. Re-runs on any reactive read inside `EXPR`. Auto-tracked.

directives.name: data
directives.description: Server-sourced signal — implicitly live. Subscribed via SSE; initial value is `null`. RHS must be a `ship.*` schema-source call. For local seed, use `state`.

anti_examples.reason: RHS must be `ship.<domain>.<op>(...)`. Use `state` for seed.

directives.name: function
directives.description: Plain JS in component scope. Has access to all injected scope bindings.

directives.name: event
directives.description: Typed CustomEvent declaration. Surfaces in the `.d.ts` as a known dispatch target.

directives.name: component_form_associated
directives.description: Element-level config. Attaches `ElementInternals` and exposes it as `internals`. Required before any `on form_*` hook.

scope_bindings.name: el
scope_bindings.description: The host custom element instance. Use for `el.dispatchEvent`, `el.querySelector`, `el.setAttribute`, etc.

scope_bindings.name: internals
scope_bindings.description: Set when `component formAssociated` is declared. Use for `internals.setFormValue(...)` and friends.

scope_bindings.name: props
scope_bindings.description: Read-only proxy. `props.X` is `X()` — alternate access shape.

scope_bindings.name: cleanups
scope_bindings.description: Push disposers for `mount`-time setup that needs teardown. The runtime calls them on unmount.

scope_bindings.name: slotFilled
scope_bindings.description: Returns true iff the named slot received caller-provided content.

lifecycle_hooks.name: mount
lifecycle_hooks.fires: Once on `connectedCallback` after the DOM is wired.
lifecycle_hooks.description: One-time setup. Push to `cleanups` for subscriptions that need teardown.

lifecycle_hooks.name: effect
lifecycle_hooks.fires: On any reactive read inside the body changing.
lifecycle_hooks.description: Auto-tracked. The parser also accepts `effect on X { … }` and `effect once { … }`, but auto-tracking is the preferred shape — `effect on X` is redundant whenever the body already reads `X()`.

lifecycle_hooks.name: form_reset
lifecycle_hooks.fires: When the parent `<form>` is reset (form-associated only).

lifecycle_hooks.name: form_restore
lifecycle_hooks.fires: When the browser restores form state (BFCache / autofill).
lifecycle_hooks.description: Lifecycle hook for `formStateRestoreCallback`. Param name pulls from `e.detail.<param>`.

lifecycle_hooks.name: form_disabled
lifecycle_hooks.fires: When the host form's `disabled` state toggles.

template_syntax.name: interpolation
template_syntax.description: Reactive text interpolation. Re-renders the text node when any signal read inside `EXPR` changes.

template_syntax.name: attribute_interpolation
template_syntax.description: Reactive attribute. Empty / null / undefined / `false` auto-omit. `true` becomes presence-only.

template_syntax.name: event_attribute
template_syntax.description: Any `on*` attr with an interpolated value is an event listener. Use platform names; `on:click` prefix is removed.

template_syntax.name: two_way_binding
template_syntax.description: Two-way binding for form inputs. The runtime owns the input listener.

template_syntax.name: bind_callback
template_syntax.description: Side-effect callback for `bind:value`. After the runtime writes the signal on user input, `FN(newValue)` fires — for dispatching public events, syncing form state, etc. Not invoked on programmatic signal writes. Pair with `bind:value` only.

template_syntax.name: if_block
template_syntax.description: Mustache control flow. `:elif` is also accepted as shorthand.

template_syntax.name: for_block
template_syntax.description: List rendering. Optional `key={EXPR}` for stable identity.

template_syntax.name: await_block
template_syntax.description: Async control flow. Loading branch until the promise settles.

template_syntax.name: raw_html
template_syntax.description: Raw HTML interpolation. Author owns sanitisation.

template_syntax.name: slot
template_syntax.description: Light-DOM slot. Body is the fallback when no caller content arrives.

template_syntax.name: slot_fill
template_syntax.syntax: slot="NAME" on a child of a custom-element call
template_syntax.description: Routes a child into the named slot of the consumed component. The `slot=` attr is stripped after distribution; query via `slotFilled(el, 'name')`.

template_syntax.name: host_attrs
template_syntax.description: Reactive bindings on the component's host element. Replaces the `mount + effect + el.setAttribute` ritual. Self-closing only.

template_syntax.name: style_external
template_syntax.description: External stylesheet. Inlined at compile time.

template_syntax.name: component_call
template_syntax.description: Custom-element invocation. Resolved against the registry.

reactivity_rules.name: signal_call_required
reactivity_rules.description: Reading a signal in expression context requires `()`. Bare identifiers reference the signal accessor itself.

reactivity_rules.name: no_signal_set_in_template
reactivity_rules.description: Mutations belong in handlers, not templates.

reactivity_rules.name: prefer_auto_tracked_effect
reactivity_rules.description: `effect` auto-tracks reactive reads. The legacy `effect on X { … }` form still parses but is redundant whenever the body reads `X()`; prefer the bare form.

reactivity_rules.name: platform_event_attrs
reactivity_rules.description: Event handlers use platform attribute names. `on:click` prefix is removed.

reactivity_rules.name: no_bind_with_oninput
reactivity_rules.description: `bind:value` already attaches an input listener. Don't pair with `oninput`.

reactivity_rules.name: data_is_implicitly_live
reactivity_rules.description: `data` is server-sourced and always live. Static seeds use `state X = expr`.

components.description:
<ship-accordion-item> — single section of a <ship-accordion>. Renders
a trigger button + collapsible content region. The host's [open]
attribute is managed by the parent accordion; this component reacts
to it via the open prop (CSS uses :host([open]) for chevron rotation
and content-wrap height transition).

Attributes (host):
value     — string; unique identifier, required.
disabled  — boolean; trigger is non-interactive when set.
open      — boolean; managed by parent accordion.

Slots:
trigger   — header content rendered inside the button.
(default) — body content shown when open.

Events (bubbling, internal — used by parent <ship-accordion>):
ship-accordion-item-toggle — { value }
ship-accordion-nav         — { direction: 'next'|'prev'|'first'|'last' }

<ship-accordion> — disclosable list of sections. Children are
<ship-accordion-item> elements; this parent coordinates which are
open and handles keyboard focus traversal.

Attributes:
type   — 'single' | 'multiple' (default 'single').
single: at most one item open at a time.
multiple: any subset of items can be open.
value  — comma-separated list of open item values. Reflected to
attribute on user toggle.

Events:
ship-change — CustomEvent { detail: { value: string } }, bubbles,
composed. value is the post-toggle value attribute
(single id, comma-list, or '').

Internal events listened to (bubbled from items):
ship-accordion-item-toggle — toggle the named item.
ship-accordion-nav         — focus next/prev/first/last enabled item.

Agents index page. Server-truth via the sail data resolver wired in
`apps/shipd/src/views/sail_data_resolvers/agents.rs`. The signal
updates whenever the kernel emits a `config.*` event (agent file
create / edit / delete in either project or global scope), so the
page reflects the registry without a refresh.

— identity glyph for a Ship app surface. Used by the rail, dock, launcher, breadcrumbs, and anywhere an app needs to be named visually. Single source of truth for the app→glyph + app→hue mapping. Attributes: name — app id. dashboard | pipelines | agents | skills | git | collections | canvas | settings | chat | events | specs | theme | setup | overview | mesh. The alias `theme-studio` resolves to `theme`. Unknown names render the slot or a neutral "dot" glyph. variant — glyph (default, no tile) | tile (soft tinted bg) | solid (filled accent bg). size — sm | md | lg (default md). 16/20/28px tile, 12/14/18 glyph. radius — sm | md | lg | full — overrides the size-derived default. label — when set, host gets role=img + aria-label; otherwise aria-hidden. Slots: (default) — escape hatch for marketplace / extension views to provide a custom glyph (raw , or a ).

<ship-breadcrumb-item> — one rung of a breadcrumb path. Renders
either an <a href> (when href is set and not active) or a span
label with aria-current=page (when active).

Attributes:
href   — URL (renders as <a> when present and not active).
active — boolean; marks the current path step.

<ship-breadcrumb> — path-navigation primitive. Hosts one or more
<ship-breadcrumb-item> children; chevron separators are inserted
between siblings and re-synced via MutationObserver when items
are added or removed.

Slots:
(default) — one or more <ship-breadcrumb-item>.

<ship-collapsible> — open/close container with smooth height
animation. Trigger slot toggles a content region.

Attributes:
open      — boolean; whether the content is visible.
disabled  — boolean; prevents toggling.

Slots:
trigger   — the element that toggles open/close.
(default) — collapsible content.

Events:
ship-toggle — CustomEvent { open: boolean }.

<ship-copy-button> — copies `value` to the clipboard on click.
Shows a checkmark flash for 1.2s after a successful copy.

Attributes:
value  — string to copy.
label  — accessible label (default "Copy").

Events:
ship-copy { value: string } — fired after a successful copy.

Slots:
(default) — button label content (falls back to icon + label text).

Workspace Dashboard. Server-truth via the sail data resolver:
`ship.dashboard.state()` → `{ stats, recent_runs, events, agents,
collections, total_events }`. The signal updates whenever the daemon
emits a relevant event (runs, agent config, collection schemas, the
event stream itself), so the page reflects the registry without a
refresh.

Behavior parity vs `.ship/views/dashboard/index.html.j2`:
- Header with ship-app-icon wordmark + live-pulse badge
- 4 stat tiles with per-tile accent stripes (jobs / agents / events / collections)
- Recent jobs list (active or, if none, history truncated to 5)
- Agents grid (first 6, brand-aware avatar via shared resolver inlined here)
- Latest events feed (3-col grid: ts / type / actor)
- Quick-links tile row (6 hardcoded routes — same catalog as the partial)
- Empty states for jobs / agents / events

Out of scope (not provided by the data resolver, not present in the
Jinja either): the `settings.workspace_name` line is rendered as
the hardcoded "workspace dashboard" subtitle, matching the Jinja
`{% else %}workspace dashboard{% endif %}` branch.

<ship-error-state> — sibling of <ship-empty-state> for the
"something broke" path. Routes every view's error branch through
one component so failures read deliberately (destructive halo,
clear title, actionable body, optional collapsible technical
details, primary retry).

Attributes:
title, body, size (sm|md|lg), variant (default|inline), icon

Slots:
title, default (body), details, action

<ship-field> — vertical stack for a label + control + hint/error.
Presentational wrapper; the slotted control owns the form value, so
this component is NOT formAssociated.

Attributes:
invalid — boolean. When set, the error slot is revealed and the
hint slot is hidden via CSS. Also flips the wired
control's `invalid` prop (or aria-invalid, on plain
native elements) and points its aria-describedby at
the error region instead of the hint.

Slots:
label     — label element (e.g. <ship-label>).
(default) — the control. Wired via querySelector at mount and
re-wired on light-DOM mutations + when `invalid`
flips. The first non-named child is the canonical
control.
hint      — muted helper text under the control.
error     — destructive-toned error text. Replaces hint when
invalid is set.

<ship-icon> — canonical inline SVG icon. Resolves `name` against the
curated Lucide registry generated from `lucide-static` (ISC). Names
not present in the curated allowlist fall through to the default
slot — provide raw SVG there for one-off glyphs.

Attributes:
name  — Lucide icon id, kebab-case (e.g. "chevron-right"). A small
alias map handles legacy names (`stop` → `stop-circle`,
`refresh` → `refresh-cw`, `git` → `git-branch`,
`warning` → `triangle-alert`).
size  — sm | md | lg (default md). 12 / 16 / 20px.
tone  — default | info | success | warning | destructive | accent
| muted | primary
label — when provided, the host gets role=img + aria-label;
otherwise aria-hidden is set.

Slots:
(default) — raw SVG passthrough. Used as a fallback when `name`
is not in the registry.

<ship-label> — section/field label. Typography matches specs
.meta-title and the pipelines .stat-label uppercase micro-kicker.

Attributes:
for       — id of the associated control. Mirrored onto the inner
native <label for=…>. Read via mount + MutationObserver
because the framework's prop→attribute kebab rule
(htmlFor → "html-for") doesn't let us name the
attribute "for" directly. See gaps.md.
size      — sm | md (default sm).
required  — boolean; appends "*" after the label.

Slots:
(default) — label text.

ship-list-tile — generic row/card tile primitive. Visual rhythm,
density, and tone live here; navigation does NOT. Wrap in <a href>
when you want a link — the platform already knows how to do that
and gives cmd-click, middle-click, prefetch, view-transitions, etc.
for free.

Slots: leading, default (primary), meta (secondary), trailing.
Event: ship-select — bubbles, composed, cancelable. Dispatched when
`interactive` and the user clicks or presses Enter/Space.

<ship-mark> — the SHIP brand mark. The original asset is a 9-layer
SVG with six fixed amber fills + a white silhouette; this collapses
those fills into named classes painted from --primary + --background
via color-mix, so every theme renders the mark in its own palette
without swapping assets.

Attributes:
size  — sm | md | lg (default md). 22 / 28 / 48px square.

<ship-markdown-editor-bubble> — selection bubble + comment composer
for the markdown editor. Pure view+events: receives position +
visibility + mark booleans from the parent; dispatches mark-toggle
+ action events back. Composer text is held in local state and
returned to the parent only on submit/cancel — parent flips
`pending-active` to true to open with `pending-text` as the
quoted selection.

<ship-markdown-editor-toolbar> — main editor toolbar. Pure
view+events: receives mark booleans + disabled + label as
attributes from the parent <ship-markdown-editor>; dispatches
`ship-mark-toggle` and `ship-link-click` back up. The parent owns
the editor instance and drives all TipTap commands.

<ship-markdown-editor> — TipTap-backed markdown editor island.
Owns the editor instance, value sync, mark map, bubble position,
and pending-comment state. Toolbar + bubble live in sibling .set
sub-components. TipTap graph lazy-loads from
`./ship-markdown-editor.init.ts` so element registration stays
light. Public methods (focus) and dispose use existing primitives.

<ship-pagination> — pagination bar with prev/next buttons + info.

Attributes:
page      — current page (1-based, default 1).
total     — total number of items.
per-page  — items per page (default 25).
tone      — default | info | success | warning | destructive | accent.

Events:
ship-change — CustomEvent { page: number }.

<ship-tooltip> — CSS-only tooltip positioned via absolute offsets.
Wraps its trigger as light-DOM children; the `content` slot
provides the bubble body. Shows on hover and on keyboard focus —
the visibility transition lives entirely in CSS via :host(:hover)
and :host(:focus-within), so this component carries no event
state, no positioning JS, and no portal escape from the host.

Attributes:
placement — top | bottom | left | right (default top).
delay     — number, ms show delay (default 100). Currently a
passthrough — see comments below.

Slots:
(default) — trigger content.
content   — tooltip body.
